_about: Survival know-how: what to do first and how to prepare.

first_day.fact: Wood, crafting table, wooden then stone tools, food, shelter or a bed before night (sleeping skips it).

progression.fact: Stone -> iron (tools, armour, bucket, shield) -> diamond -> enchanting table (books around it for level 30) -> Nether (blaze rods, ender pearls, netherite) -> eyes of ender -> stronghold -> End.

food.fact: Saturation matters more than hunger points: cooked steak and porkchop are among the best, golden carrots the best overall; hunger below 6 stops sprinting; health regenerates when hunger is 18 or more.

safe_mining.fact: Don't dig straight down or up; watch for lava below Y 0 (lava lakes) and gravel or sand above. Carry water and blocks.

nether_prep.fact: Gold armour piece for piglins, Fire Resistance potions, blocks, food, a way back (remember the portal).

end_prep.fact: 12 eyes of ender (some portals have eyes already), a bow and arrows for caged crystals, beds or blocks, water bucket, ender pearls, food, slow falling helps.

enchanting.fact: 15 bookshelves around the table (one block gap) give level 30 enchantments. Anvils combine enchantments; renaming and repairs get more expensive with each use. Mending and Unbreaking keep gear forever.

armour_trims_and_netherite.fact: Netherite upgrades diamond gear at a smithing table with a netherite upgrade template (from bastions) and an ingot (4 scrap + 4 gold).
